name: input-otp
description: A one-time password input built from individual slot cells grouped into a single control.

invalid.notes: Uses [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector to beat data-[state=open]/focus-visible specificity. Blue ring must NOT appear when invalid.

accessibility.label: Always provide a visible label associated with the input.
accessibility.disabled: disabled attribute removes from tab order.
accessibility.touchTarget: Slots are visually 40x40px; implementation should ensure 44x44px hit area.
keyboard: Home and End move to first and last slot

constraints: Choose Type by code format, not visual preference.
Show Invalid only after submission of an incorrect code.
Provide one error message below the field, not one per slot.
Always provide a label and description explaining code source.

useCases: Email verification during signup — 'Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your email'
Two-factor authentication (2FA) — one-time code from an authenticator app
SMS-based login or phone number verification
PIN entry for a locked account or secure action confirmation
Password reset flows where a code is sent before the user can set a new password

6-Slot.whenToUse: Standard 6-digit code with no visual grouping

3+3.whenToUse: 6-character code that is formatted with a visible separator in the message

comparedTo.situation: User enters a structured verification or PIN code in individual slots
User enters any general text, password, or free-form value
User needs to enter a numeric quantity or free number (not a code)

notes: Examples assume an Agentic InputOTP wrapper over shadcn/input-otp primitives; source markdown itself does not mark this component not ready.

changelog.change: Active slot: switched from inset shadow to ring-2 ring-offset-0 z-10 (shadcn pattern). No overflow-hidden on group. Per-slot borders instead. First/last slots get radius/md - 1px corner radius.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.

notes: Active slot uses ring-2 ring-offset-0 z-10 (shadcn pattern) — NOT inset shadow. No overflow-hidden on group.
Slot corner radius = calc(radius/md - 1px) so inset follows group border inner edge.
